description: Decodes an embedded Base64-encoded and XOR-obfuscated shellcode payload in memory, allocates local process memory, copies the decoded shellcode into the allocated region, changes the region to executable, and starts a local thread at the decoded payload address.

loader.role: decodes the embedded payload, allocates local memory, stages the decoded shellcode, changes memory protection, and launches execution through a new local thread

payload.role: Base64-encoded and XOR-obfuscated x64 shellcode executed from local process memory after runtime decoding
payload.payload_generation: nasm -f win64 calc.asm -o calc.obj; objcopy -O binary calc.obj calc.bin; xxd -i calc.bin; XOR raw shellcode with key 0x5A; Base64-encode XOR output

generator.role: helper utility used to convert raw shellcode bytes into the Base64-encoded XOR-obfuscated blob embedded in the loader

loader: Convert.FromBase64String
VirtualAlloc
Marshal.Copy
VirtualProtect
CreateThread
WaitForSingleObject

obfuscation.embedded_blob_type: Base64 string containing XOR-obfuscated shellcode bytes

payload_behavior.description: After runtime decoding, the shellcode resolves kernel32.dll and WinExec dynamically, builds the calc.exe command string on the stack, and invokes WinExec to launch Calculator.
expected_actions: copy decoded shellcode into allocated memory
create local thread at decoded shellcode address
walk loaded module structures to locate kernel32.dll
build the calc.exe argument on the stack

code_placement: Shellcode is stored as a Base64 string containing XOR-obfuscated bytes and is decoded into private memory inside the current process at runtime
execution_trigger: Immediate execution via CreateThread with decoded shellcode memory as the thread start address

semantic_meaning: Demonstrates an obfuscated fileless shellcode loader pattern in which the payload is concealed from static analysis using Base64 encoding and XOR obfuscation, reconstructed only at runtime, staged into executable memory, and executed directly inside the current process.

control_notes.payload_effect: launches calc.exe as a benign execution marker
control_notes.obfuscation_purpose: conceals recognizable shellcode bytes and payload strings from straightforward static inspection
